name: N2 LOUNGE
description_short: Relaxed neighbourhood bar in Kwanokuthula serving drinks and good vibes to locals and visitors alike.
description_long:
Tucked away in Kwanokuthula, N2 Lounge offers a genuine local experience just off the main route through Plettenberg Bay. This is where community meets, whether you're catching up with friends over cold beers or settling in to watch the big game on screen.

The atmosphere is unpretentious and welcoming, with a loyal local following that gives the place its authentic character. It's a straightforward spot for drinks and socialising, where you'll find friendly faces and a relaxed vibe that's refreshingly different from the tourist-focused venues closer to the beaches. A true neighbourhood gem that offers visitors a glimpse into the real Plett.
